text: A laboratory bench with aluminium rails holding labelled positions marked by white/purple labels and black-and-white square barcode tags. On the left, black plastic racks hold upright conical tubes with orange screw caps, all closed; several contain clear or slightly cloudy liquid, others appear empty. Along the rails at centre and right stand three white plastic squeeze/dropper bottles, upright and capped with red conical nozzle caps; their collars are green, blue and red respectively. Nearby are two low white round-domed vessels seated in rail positions, plus a smaller white cap-like piece at right. In the background sit clear plastic pipette-tip racks and stacked white trays on a shelf against a pale wall.
